ask: Should a person's own recordings leave the phone once the server has confirmed them?
problem: Today a person's own recordings stay on their phone for good. Phones fill up, as they did in the old app. The issue asks us to clear them after upload.
found: Other people's audio is cleared when space runs low, after the server confirms it. But passages a person recorded in stay kept for good, so their own audio is never cleared. Nothing clears right after upload.
changed: Nothing yet. This is a decision card only. No code is built until you answer.
why: Three choices fit the issue. Keeping everything is simplest but fills phones. Clearing when space is low matches the issue's rule 'like any other cached audio' and lets people still hear their work offline while there is room. Clearing a week after upload frees space sooner but breaks offline listening for people who work in low-signal places. I recommend B. Whichever you pick, a file is never cleared before the server confirms it.
touches: Choosing B or C changes decision 166, which keeps every passage a person worked on. The download button would stop saying 'kept because you worked on it'. The play-store answers about data on the device stay true.
